parts.title: WRITING TASK 1
parts.passage:
WRITING TASK 1

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Categories of library users:
Distance learning (all courses)
Part-time postgraduate
Full-time postgraduate
Full-time undergraduate

Library user satisfaction (%):
Library opening hours: Very satisfied 65, Fairly satisfied 35, Not satisfied 0
Helpfulness of staff: Very satisfied 95, Fairly satisfied 5, Not satisfied 0
Availability of books: Very satisfied 50, Fairly satisfied 40, Not satisfied 10
Availability of journals: Very satisfied 45, Fairly satisfied 35, Not satisfied 20
Reliability of wi-fi: Very satisfied 48, Fairly satisfied 33, Not satisfied 19

questions.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
questions.content: Write your response for Task 1 here.

parts.title: WRITING TASK 2
parts.passage:
WRITING TASK 2

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning.

To what extent do you agree with this opinion?

How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questions.instruction: Write an essay on the given topic. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
questions.content: Write your response for Task 2 here.
